text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, is that today? Thanks for the<n>reminder. I
needed to make updates<n>to all of my data.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? How could you forget your<n>birthday?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, age itself can be important for<n>research, but
what I find most<n>intriguing is recording the effects
of<n>time on the body, and—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec... Is no one celebrating<n>your birthday
with you?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? No, not really... I do receive gifts,<n>but such
things are nonnecessities—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Then let's have a party for you! I'll<n>go get
everyone together right now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, listen to me. Though it'd be<n>beneficial for my
test subjects to<n>gather in one place, their attention
on<n>me would make observing rather<n>diffi—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We'll get all sorts of food too. Oh, and<n>I've already
got your present. I bet<n>you're going to love it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This'll be great, Tachyon. You're<n>going to get a
party you'll remember<n>for the rest of your life!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...I'm always perplexed by that force<n>of will and
inability to listen of yours.<n>Perhaps it's some
hereditary trait<n>from your parents?
